title: Along a path
passage: A. The path runs between two trees. B. The trees are being trimmed. C. Two people are resting on a bench. D. A vehicle is parked under a tree.
passageZh:
A. 步道穿過兩棵樹之間。
B. 樹木正在被修剪。
C. 兩個人在長椅上休息。
D. 一輛車停在樹下。
